steps.name: bf16-prepare
steps.config: get_default_config("BF16") + BF16QDQToCast=true + EnableVaimlBF16=true, then restore_float_inputs (collapse input QDQ/Cast chains to float graph inputs; numerically exact, checker-verified)
steps.calibration: 32 COCO128 images, PIL RGB bilinear resized to the model geometry (320x320 for 320 models, 640x640 for 640 models), /255, CHW
steps.rationale: Quark BF16QDQToCast leaves BF16-fed Cast nodes that onnxruntime-vitisai 1.27 refuses to load (first seen on a yolov9s-320 Plus model: inputShape nchw). EnableVaimlBF16 removes BF16 Cast couples; the input-edge repair restores the original float32 input (what the probe feeds). Graphs without such chains are unaffected.

steps.name: vaiml-compile (no in-child probe)
steps.probe_note: The zeros probe runs out-of-child via the launcher through the real resident worker path (fresh process, device lease held): the 512 MB probe mapping fails inside the compile child under its address-space cap even for valid artifacts.

environment.note: XRT lib dir must precede voe's bundled libxrt_coreutil 2.19.184
environment.XILINX_XRT: <xrt prefix> (required: without it the EP compiles binaries but refuses inference runs)

target_profile: xc10AIE2P_ML-die-0x-e-S-es1 (Strix Halo XDNA2/AIE2P, verbatim from audited compile log)
native_abi_closure: voe/lib: libxcompiler-mlir-e2e.so, libxcompiler-xcompiler-core.so.1, libxcompiler-core-without-symbol.so, libaiecompiler_client.so, libdyn_dispatch_core.so, libflexmlrt.so, libaie_codegen.so.3, libxrt_coreutil.so
include/: aie_api + adf headers; vitis_mllib/ tree; data/*.json schemas
payload_note: Digest of the B1 actually-used file manifest (local evidence). The full file-level binary manifest is built by the Task 03 packaging step; this digest pins the audited set.
